ns2:course.label: Audience Analysis
ns2:course.description: Analyzes the markets served by various advertising media and factors to consider in the selection and evaluation of media. No graduate credit. Prerequisite: ADV 481.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Agr & Environmental Cmc & Educ or Advertising or Agricultural Communications major(s). Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing.
